## Webhook Trigger
This node listens for the event on the bookmarklet we are going to create.
The settings for this should be POST

## Adding data to notion
Go to your notion database and add a new database that shall be recording all your bookmarks. Make sure to add your application. (If you do not add this your bookmark wont be saved)

Test the webhook with to see how the urls are formated in the database
